hooks.command: jq -r '.command // empty' | grep -qE 'git\s+add\s+(-A|--all|\.)(\s|$)' && echo 'BLOCKED: Use explicit file staging (git add <file>) instead of git add . / -A / --all' && exit 2 || exit 0
jq -r '.command // empty' | grep -qE '\b--no-verify\b' && echo 'BLOCKED: --no-verify is forbidden. Fix the pre-commit errors instead.' && exit 2 || exit 0
jq -r '.command // empty' | grep -qE '\b--dangerously-skip-permissions\b' && echo 'BLOCKED: --dangerously-skip-permissions is forbidden.' && exit 2 || exit 0

FILE=$(jq -r '.file_path // empty') && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.env(\.[a-z]+)*$' && ! echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.env\.example$' && echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot modify .env files (except .env.example). Edit secrets manually.' && exit 2 || exit 0
